title: Looking for feedback on my trailer
author: W0RKABLE
selftext:
Based on the trailer, do you understand what kind of game it is, and how is it played?

What do you think about the content and the music?

Any feedback welcome :)

comments.author: FutureLynx_
comments.body: loved the minigames and the concept. On the target practice minigame i didnt understand why different answers got different bonuses if only one is right?

replies.author: W0RKABLE
replies.body: Thank you! It might be the one where you type characters that are floating on the screen. Letters give you 1 point, numbers 2 points, and special characters 3 points.

replies.author: FutureLynx_
replies.body: where can i follow this project?

replies.author: W0RKABLE
replies.body:
Tavernia has a discord server where I post all the major updates to the game, that would be the best place. Thanks!

https://discord.gg/r25E35KJuQ

replies.author: FutureLynx_
replies.body: no not discord. im already full in servers. something like [itch.io](http://itch.io), steam or youtube?

replies.author: W0RKABLE
replies.body:
In that case just the browser version, you can play it there as well: https://tavernia.io

Steam release is planned later this year :)

replies.author: FutureLynx_
replies.body: ok thanks. let me know when its in [itch.io](http://itch.io) or steam or anything
